As the weather cools and peak season for autumn outdoor activities arrives, I adjust my everyday carry list to match how I spend my time. The Pelican MagSafe wallet and card case is my top pick — it is rugged enough to handle the outdoors, yet also an excellent everyday wallet.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers rounds up the latest and greatest MagSafe and wireless charging products to help you get the most out of your wireless-charging-supported Apple devices.

A must-have for outdoor activities

The Pelican wallet carries an IPX4 water-resistance rating, which means even if it gets splashed on a hike or by the lake, your credit cards and cash stay dry. Once it snaps on, it locks firmly in place. In my own case, I go to Falcons games often in the autumn, and even when I'm watching football, I like knowing everything is tucked away and locked in. That alone makes it a dependable choice for autumn outings, given how quickly the weather can change. It feels less like a wallet that magnetically attaches to your iPhone, and more like a small hard-shell protective case.

Most MagSafe wallets on the market are designed to hold only a few cards, with very little flexibility. Pelican's design gives you a bit more room to adapt. It easily holds an ID and credit cards, and there's space for a small amount of folded cash and a slim key. If you want to travel light on a hike, this wallet covers the basics without needing to carry an extra bag.

Although the Pelican wallet is built for the outdoors, it works just as well as an everyday carry. The strong magnet keeps it firmly attached to the back of an iPhone, and the snap closure keeps everything from falling out. Compared with MagSafe wallets that aren't as rugged, this one sacrifices a little slimness in exchange for greater peace of mind. In the summer, when I want something light and minimal, I probably wouldn't choose it; but for hiking, watching football, or any time I'm out and about and the weather could turn, it's the most fitting choice. It's also a great MagSafe wallet for a kid's first iPhone. My older son has been using one for years.

Pelican MagSafe wallet: the verdict

The Pelican MagSafe wallet is built for users who value durability — it protects your everyday items from the weather and moisture, holds the essentials you need for a hike or day trip, and snaps securely onto the back of your phone. If you're after a MagSafe wallet that can take a tumble and still serve you day to day, this is the one.

You can buy the Pelican MagSafe wallet directly from Amazon or from Pelican's official website.
